issues.title: Epic: onboarding
issues.body:
Onboarding workstream.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] New users can sign up
- [ ] Existing users can migrate

issues.title: Onboard via OAuth
issues.body:
Implement OAuth 2.0 login with Google and GitHub providers.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Provider buttons render on the login screen
- [ ] Token exchange returns a session cookie
- [ ] Session refresh on expiry

issues.title: Onboarding email
issues.body: Send a welcome email after signup.
